name: Lying straight-bar triceps extension
definition: Lie on a flat bench holding a straight bar above the torso with the upper arms directed upward. Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward a chosen forehead-adjacent endpoint, then extend.

value.range_of_motion: Use a defined non-contact endpoint and relatively fixed upper-arm angle.
